# Calibration report

<!-- Generated by test/cases/calibration-report.test.ts. Do not edit by hand; regenerate with `pnpm vitest run test/cases -u`. -->

The default weights and thresholds checked against the [hard-case table](../test/cases/match-cases.ts): **42 of 45 cases pass**, 3 are documented known limitations.

The expected answers were written before any matching code existed (five were added later and are marked in the table: the spelling variants, to document limitations, and two kinds of twins, false matches that reviews found and fixed) and are never changed to make a case pass. Points are a heuristic, not a calibrated probability model: they were set by hand against these cases, without real data.

## Defaults

`match` at 14 points (plus no veto and agreeing name, birth date and one of identifier, phone, email or address), `possible` at 8 points (plus no veto and one agreeing field besides the name). A missing value scores 0.

| Field | exact | fuzzy | conflict |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| identifier | 10 | 0 | -10 |
| family | 4 | 2 | -3 |
| given | 4 | 2 | -3 |
| middle | 1 | 0.5 | 0 |
| birthDate | 5 | 2 | -6 |
| phone | 4 | 0 | -1 |
| email | 4 | 0 | -1 |
| address | 3 | 1 | -1 |
| gender | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Known limitations

- `family-spelling-variant-z-s` (family Jaro-Winkler 0.907): Souza/Sousa is below the 0.92 Jaro-Winkler cut-off, so the family names conflict. The pair goes to review (possible) instead of matching.
- `given-spelling-variant-z-s` (given Jaro-Winkler 0.883): Luiz/Luis is below the 0.92 cut-off, so the given names conflict. The pair goes to review (possible) instead of matching.
- `given-spelling-variant-k-c` (given Jaro-Winkler 0.867): Kátia/Cátia differ in the first letter, which Jaro-Winkler weighs heavily. The pair goes to review (possible) instead of matching.

## Sensitivity

For each setting alone, the smallest step (up to 10 steps of 1 point, or 0.01 for the name cut-off) that makes a passing case fail, everything else at its default. A large margin means the decision comes from the rules (vetoes, minimum evidence) rather than from a finely tuned number.

| Setting (default) | Lowered | Raised |
|---|---|---|
| identifier.exact (10) | −10: `same-cpf-same-person` | no break within +10 |
| identifier.fuzzy (0) | no break within −10 | no break within +10 |
| identifier.conflict (-10) | no break within −10 | no break within +10 |
| family.exact (4) | −2: `given-name-typo` | no break within +10 |
| family.fuzzy (2) | no break within −10 | no break within +10 |
| family.conflict (-3) | −7: `married-surname-replaced` | +9: `placeholders-are-not-agreement` |
| given.exact (4) | −3: `address-abbreviations`, `birthdate-day-month-swapped-name-only` | no break within +10 |
| given.fuzzy (2) | −2: `given-name-typo` | no break within +10 |
| given.conflict (-3) | no break within −10 | +9: `placeholders-are-not-agreement` |
| middle.exact (1) | −5: `name-only-in-text` | no break within +10 |
| middle.fuzzy (0.5) | no break within −10 | no break within +10 |
| middle.conflict (0) | no break within −10 | no break within +10 |
| birthDate.exact (5) | −2: `given-name-typo`, `newborn-registered-twice`, `newborn-named-later` | +9: `placeholders-are-not-agreement` |
| birthDate.fuzzy (2) | −3: `birthdate-day-month-swapped-name-only` | no break within +10 |
| birthDate.conflict (-6) | no break within −10 | no break within +10 |
| phone.exact (4) | −2: `given-name-typo`, `newborn-registered-twice`, `newborn-named-later` | no break within +10 |

Single settings in this range that make a known limitation pass: `family-spelling-variant-z-s` (nameSimilarity.fuzzyMin lowered by 0.02); `given-spelling-variant-z-s` (nameSimilarity.fuzzyMin lowered by 0.04); `given-spelling-variant-k-c` (nameSimilarity.fuzzyMin lowered by 0.06). The defaults keep them as limitations on purpose: no case in the table breaks at a lower cut-off, but distinct names would also count as near spellings, for example Lima/Lira (0.867).
